Demo 08: Copy Button

Testing automated one-click copy button insertion — copying raw code text (excluding HTML tags) to the clipboard.

💡 How to test: Click the Copy button on the top-right corner of any code block → then paste (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V) into the test area below to verify clean code extraction.

Block 1: JavaScript

// Fibonacci sequence
function fibonacci(n) {
    if (n <= 1) return n;
    let [a, b] = [0, 1];
    for (let i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        [a, b] = [b, a + b];
    }
    return b;
}

console.log(fibonacci(10)); // Output: 55

Block 2: Python

from pathlib import Path
import json

def load_config(path: str = "config.json") -> dict:
    """Load configuration from JSON file."""
    config_path = Path(path)
    if not config_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Config not found: {path}")

    with open(config_path, 'r') as f:
        return json.load(f)

config = load_config()
print(f"Loaded {len(config)} settings")

Block 3: SQL

-- Top 10 customers by lifetime value
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.name,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders,
    SUM(o.amount) AS lifetime_value,
    MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC
LIMIT 10;
